lead: Ellyse Perry is best known as an Australian association football player, born on 3 November 1990 in Wahroonga.
As of 2026, she is 35 years old, and her birth date places her under the Scorpio sign.
She has represented Canberra United FC and Central Coast Mariners FC W-League and has been recognised with the Wisden Cricketer of the Year.
The sections that follow break down Ellyse Perry's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

paras: Ellyse Perry works primarily as an association football player and cricketer.

On the team sheet, Ellyse has been associated with Canberra United FC (from 2009 to 2012), Central Coast Mariners FC W-League (from 2008 to 2009), Sydney FC (from 2012), Australia women's national under-20 association football team (from 2007 to 2007), Australia women's national association football team (from 2007), Australia national cricket team (from 2008 to 2015) and New South Wales Breakers (from 2007). She plays as a defender.
